backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing comment list management with CRUD operations, single-use device tracking, bulk comment generation with access keys, and role-based authorization for admin functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including comment list management, admin panel with lock/unlock controls, Internet Identity authentication, navigation fixes, and visual design with associated test IDs and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including routing, authentication, admin panels, UI components, hooks, and styling with warm neutral color palette and OKLCH-based design system.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind layers defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes, including warm neutral tones (sand, amber, orange) and semantic color tokens for UI components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading for the React application titled 'APP REVIEW'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component with TanStack Router setup defining routes for customer view, upload, live list checker, and admin panel with AdminGate component enforcing role-based access control via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminChatT: Admin tab for managing chat messages with form to add new messages (sender + message) and displays message history with timestamps.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminComme: Admin tab for managing comment lists with functionality to create lists, add comments (bulk or single), delete comments, lock/unlock lists, and clear all lists.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminImage: Admin tab displaying a grid of uploaded rating images with uploader name, timestamp, and delete functionality for each image.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLiveL: Admin tab for managing live list apps and usernames, allowing creation of apps, adding usernames (bulk or comma-separated), and deleting/resetting apps.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminSetti: Admin tab for managing the bulk generator access key, showing current key status (masked), and providing functionality to set or reset the key.
frontend/src/components/AdminTokenGate.t: Empty file placeholder for admin token-based authorization guard component.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedBackdrop: Empty file placeholder for canvas-based animated background component.
Empty file placeholder for glassmorphism-styled audio player component.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Empty file placeholder for authentication and authorization wrapper component.
frontend/src/components/EffectBurst.tsx: Empty file placeholder for visual effects component with heart explosions and confetti.
frontend/src/components/GalleryGrid.tsx: Empty file placeholder for responsive gallery grid component.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Internet Identity login/logout button with loading states, query cache clearing on logout, and warm neutral styling using gradient amber-to-orange colors.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup requiring name input, with form validation, loading states, and toast notifications using warm gradient styling.
frontend/src/components/Rotating3DObject: 3D rotating cube component with six faces rendered using CSS transforms.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Empty file placeholder for footer component with copyright and Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Main layout component that wraps the entire app with navigation, footer, and conditionally shows a profile setup modal for authenticated users without profiles.
Top navigation bar with segmented buttons for different sections (Customer View, Upload, Live List, Admin) and a login button, with admin section conditionally shown based on user permissions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and initializing access control with an admin token from URL parameters.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminComments.ts: Provides React Query hooks for admin comment list management including fetching lists with lock status, creating lists, adding/deleting comments, bulk operations, and locking/unlocking lists.
frontend/src/hooks/useBulkGeneratorKey.t: Provides hooks to check bulk generator key status, set a new key, and reset the key with automatic query invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatMessages.ts: Provides hooks to fetch all chat messages and add new chat messages with sender and message content.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: Provides hooks for comment generation including fetching available lists, generating single comments per device, and bulk comment generation with access key validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context and provider using @dfinity/auth-client, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveListChecker.ts: Provides hooks for live list username checking and admin operations including adding apps, managing usernames, deleting apps, and resetting data.
frontend/src/hooks/useRatingImages.ts: Provides hooks for uploading, fetching, and deleting rating images with uploader name tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and save the current caller's user profile with proper actor dependency handling and loading states.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system defining warm neutral and amber color palettes for light and dark modes, plus a fade-in page transition animation.
frontend/src/lib/deviceId.ts: Utility functions for generating/retrieving a stable device ID from localStorage and tracking which comment lists have been used for single-generation on the current device.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin panel page with tabbed interface for managing comments, images, chat, live lists, and settings using dedicated tab components.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerViewPage.tsx: Customer-facing page for generating single or bulk comments from selected lists, with device-based single-generation restrictions and access key validation for bulk operations.
frontend/src/pages/LiveListCheckerPage.t: Page for checking usernames against selected live list apps, with localStorage persistence for form state and results, plus CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/pages/UploadSectionPage.tsx: Page for uploading rating images with uploader name, featuring file selection, upload progress tracking, and success feedback with auto-reset.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes (sand, amber, orange), typography settings, and plugins for animations, typography, and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a comments/feedback app with list management, admin controls, and Internet Identity auth, noting known issues with button clicks and navigation in live deployment.
